mapper.select: SELECT id, agent_name AS agentName, agent_key AS agentKey, is_system AS isSystem, description, system_prompt AS systemPrompt, content, temperature, max_tokens AS maxTokens, status, version, created_by AS createdBy, published_at AS publishedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM sys_agents WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_agents (agent_name, agent_key, is_system, description, system_prompt, content, temperature, max_tokens, status, version, created_by) VALUES (#{agentName}, #{agentKey}, #{isSystem}, #{description}, #{systemPrompt}, #{content}, #{temperature}, #{maxTokens}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_agents SET status = #{status}, version = COALESCE(version, 0) + 1, published_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 1 THEN NOW() ELSE published_at END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
